results.text: The service was wonderful! This place has such a wholesome vibe to it and the older staff member was always keeping our glasses full of water...

results.owner_response_text: Thank you for the awesome review. We are so happy you had a great experience with us!

results.text: If you're looking for a very good place for authentic Italian food in Brooklyn, Dellarocco's is a must-visit. We started with the Caprese, which was incredibly fresh, and followed it up with their Margherita and Four Cheese pizzas...
results.author: Arnab B.
results.owner_response_text: Arnab, thank for the great review with some awesome pictures of the food and atmosphere. We are also so glad you enjoyed the Caprese, Margherita & Four Cheese pizzas...
